name: aevral
description: Catch security flaws before you merge. Setup skill for the Aevral GitHub App: authorization, IDOR, and business-logic reviews on pull requests, with a suggested fix you apply. Public repos are free up to 500 reviews per organization per month.

interface.shortDescription: Catch security flaws before you merge.
interface.longDescription: Aevral reviews pull requests for authorization, IDOR, and business-logic flaws, with a suggested fix you apply. This plugin does not review code locally. It walks you through installing the Aevral GitHub App so reviews run server-side. After the App is installed, the next pull request can already be reviewed, including before you claim in the console. Public repositories are free up to 500 reviews per organization per month. Private repositories are free up to 25.
defaultPrompt: Set up Aevral on this repository.
Install the Aevral GitHub App so pull requests get a security review.
Connect Aevral reviews on this repo. Do not review the diff locally.
